title: Residual screen of WASP-12, TESS Sectors 20 and 43
summary: No ≥5 robust-MAD, ≥2-cadence negative excursion outside ±0.08 phase of the known WASP-12 b transit in SAP or PDCSAP flux, for 1/2/3-day baselines, in either sector. Bounded null; no candidate. Runner: Residual screen: 0 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 2 light curve(s). Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3.5, ≤2.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 2-h dips only from depth 1.5%, 1.5% (completeness for 5000 ppm: 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that.
